content: For a hackathon-scale review screen (one file, one proposal, one confirm action), plain useState/useReducer at the top-level App component is sufficient -- no cross-route/global state need, no prop-drilling depth beyond 2 levels (App -> ReviewTable -> Cell). Zustand (less than 1kb gzipped, no Provider needed) is the fallback only if state needs to be shared across more than ~3 sibling components; skip Redux/Context entirely as unnecessary ceremony for this scope.
